name: find-supplier-contracts
description: Semantic search over supplier contract text. Answers natural-language questions like 'which suppliers can ship steel to EMEA in 2 weeks?' by calling the CAP backend's auto-declared @rag actions. No handler code — the CAP entity's @rag annotation exposes searchByMeaning and askAbout on OData automatically via @saptarishi/cds-plugin-vector-hana.
utterances: Find supplier contracts about steel coils in Europe
Which suppliers can deliver aluminum with a green-electricity certificate
Show contracts for offshore wind predictive maintenance
Who can move freight from Shanghai to Hamburg on an SLA
What are our framework agreements in raw-materials for EMEA

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: The natural-language question about supplier contracts.

parameters.name: topK
parameters.description: How many source contracts to retrieve (1-10).
